ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Processes Suspicious Parent Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect suspicious parent processes of well-known Windows processes

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\taskhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\lsm\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\lsaiso\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\SavService\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ngen\\\.exe$")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*"))) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Security\\ Client\\\\.*")) AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")) OR (parent_process_path = "None" OR (parent_process_path = "" OR parent_process_path = "\-")))
